simple.meaning: כֹּחַ (kôach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “vigor , literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 127 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 4:12. Its contexts include birth, family, firstborn, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֹּחַ (H3581).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: כֹּחַ (kôach) / H3581 is traced through Genesis 4:12, Genesis 31:6, Genesis 49:3, Exodus 9:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: vigor , literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
definitions.usage: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
definitions.full: H3581. koach I. כֹּחַ noun [masculine] a small reptile , probably a kind of lizard, in list of unclean creeping things Lev 11:30 ; ᵑ9 ᵐ5 AV chameleon ; on various opinions see Di. II. כֹּחַ see below כחח . II. כֹּחַ and ( Dan 11:6 ) כּוֺחַ noun masculine Deut 4:37 strength, power (Late Hebrew id. ); — ׳כ absolute 8:18 +; construct Num 14:17 +; suffix כֹּחִי Gen 31:6 +; כֹּחֲךָ Judg 16:6 +, כֹּחֶ֑ךָ Prov 5:10 , כֹּחֶ֑כָה 24:10 , etc.; always singular; — 1 human strength: a. physical, of Samson Judg 16:5-6 , 9 , 15 , 17 , 19 , 30 ; strength in toil Isa 44:12 ( כֹּחוֺ זְרוֺעַ ), 44:12 ; Lev 26:20 ; Neh 4:4 ; of manly vigour (in procreation) אוֺנִי וְרֵאשִׁית כֹּחִי אַתָּה Gen 49:3 (poem in J; said to Reuben); vigour in General Josh 14:11 (twice in verse) (JE), Judg 6:14 ; 1Sam 28:22 ; Job 6:11-12 , Psa 31:11 ; 38:11 ; 71:9 ; 102:24 ; Prov 20:29 ; as sustained by food 1Kin 19:8 ; lack of such vigour is לֹאכֹֿחַ Job 26:2 , compare מִכֹּחַ Jer 48:45 without strength ; ׳בְּלֹאכֿ Lam 1:6 ; ׳יְגִיעֵיכֿ Job 3:17 ; בוֺ לֹאהָֿיָה כֹּחַ 1Sam 28:20 , compare Dan 10:8 , 17 ; in Psa 22:16 read חִכִּי , so Ew Ol Che and others; specifically of power of voice Isa 40:9 . b. more inclusively , ability, efficiency: followed by infinitive, ability to weep 1Sam 30:4 ; to get wealth Deut 8:18 ; to bring forth (a child; in figure) 2Kin 19:3 = Isa 37:3 ; followed by לַעֲמֹד Dan 1:4 ; Ezra 10:13 , compare Dan 11:15 ; without infinitive 1Chr 29:2 ; Ezra 2:69 ; of efficiency in battle 2Chr 14:10 ; 20:12 ; 26:13 ; for porter's service in temple לַעֲבֹדָה בַּכֹּחַ אִישׁחַֿיִל 1Chr 26:8 ; ability or efficiency in General Gen 31:6 ; Prov 24:5 , 10 ; Eccl 4:1 ; 9:10 , so probably יְדֵיהֶם כֹּחַ Job 30:2 ; כֹּחַ עָצַר (late, compare עצר ) retain ability or strength , followed by infinitive; כ ׳נַעְצֹר לְהִתְנַדֵּב 1Chr 29:14 that we should retain (have) ability to make freewill-oferings ; to build 2Chr 2:5 ; with negative, without infinitive, Dan 10:8 , 16 (compare 11:6 , c ). c. power of a people, or king, Josh 17:17 ; Nahum 2:2 ; Hab 1:11 ; Isa 49:4 (of servant of ׳י ), Lam 1:14 ; Dan 8:22 , 24 a, also 8:24 b (si vera lectio, see Bev), 11:25 (|| לֵבָב ); with עָצַר 2Chr 13:20 ; 22:9 ; Dan 11:6 ( כ תַעְצֹר ׳לֹא הַזְּרוֺעַ , compare b ); in Hosea 7:9 figurative of body seems combined with that of land yielding produce (see 5 below) d. power opposed to that of God Amos 2:14 ; Isa 10:13 ( ׳כ יָדִי ), Deut 8:17 ; 1Sam 2:9 ; Zech 4:6 ; Job 36:19 ; Psa 33:16 . e. power conferred by God Isa 40:29 , compare 40:31 ; 41:1 ; of prophetic power Micah 3:8 . 2 strength of angels Psa 103:20 . 3 power of God: in creation Jer 10:12 ; 51:15 (see also 32:17 below), Psa 65:7 ; in governing the world 1Chr 29:12 ; 2Chr 20:6 ; Psa 29:4 ; in acts of deliverance and judgment Exod 9:16 ; 15:6 ; 32:11 ; Num 14:13 , 17 (JE), Isa 50:2 ; 2Chr 25:8 ; Job 9:19 ; 24:22 ; 26:12 ; 30:18 ; 36:22 ; in combination גָּדוֺל כֹּחַ Deut 4:37 ; || חֲזָקָה יָד Exod 32:11 (JE), Neh 1:10 ; || נְטוּיָה זְרוֺעַ Deut 9:29 ; 2Kin 17:36 ; Jer 27:5 ; 32:17 ; he is רַבכֹּֿחַ Psa 147:5 ; compare כֹּחוֺ רֹב Isa 63:1 ; Job 23:6 ; also גדולכֹּֿחַ Nahum 1:3 ; כֹּחַ אַמִּיץ Isa 40:26 ; Job 9:4 , שַׂגִּיאכֹֿחַ 37:23 ; מַעֲשָׂיו כֹּחַ Psa 111:6 the power of his works ; י ׳קוֺל בַּכֹּחַ 29:4 (of thunder); specifically of his wisdom (rather peculiarly, Elihu) לֵב כֹּחַ כַּבִּיר Job 36:5 mighty in strength of mind. 4 of animals : wild ox Job 39:11 , horse 39:21 , hippopotamus 40:16 , bullock Prov 14:4 ; he-goat Dan 8:6 ram 8:7 . 5 strength , of soil i.e. produce , Gen 4:12 (J), Job 31:30 ; ( Hosea 7:9 see 1. c above); = wealth (compare חַילִ ) Prov 5:10 ; Job 6:22 .
